ledger.problem: Could the real flying fish sustain level flight on aerobic power (the question of physics test 4)?
ledger.description: Cypselurus hiraii specimen L3 (W 0.5886 N) claimed to sustain level lift-supported flight at the low end of the field airspeeds, 10 m/s, at its measured (L/D)max 4.37, with the physiology chain's cardiac output, arterial O2 content, efficiency and oxycaloric equivalent for a 0.06 kg fish in water (the generous case: in air the gills do not ventilate and the arterial content only falls).
ledger.source: physics/glide-data.csv (W, L/D, field speed); physiology/cardiac.js, haemoglobin.js, index.js, muscle.js at commit a1ca4f00 (see chain_inputs)
ledger.eliminationCaveat: eliminates the quantitative form given here to a source hypothesis, under the committed inputs (proxies where so labelled), not the source itself

ledger.problem: Could the HYPOTHETICAL flier F1 sustain powered level flight at 7 m/s on aerobic power?
ledger.description: The physics thread's hypothetical flier F1 (same 0.06 kg body, enlarged fins) claimed to sustain level flight at 7 m/s at (L/D)max 4.37 with the same physiology chain, using the arterial O2 content at take-off (the generous bound: in air the gills do not ventilate and the store drains).
ledger.source: physics/flier/spec.json; physiology/ at commit a1ca4f00 (see chain_inputs); the physics polar gives P_req 1.42 W at 7 m/s, above the 0.94 W that (L/D)max 4.37 gives, so this is the generous case
ledger.eliminationCaveat: ELIMINATES ILLUSTRATIVE NUMBERS chosen to make the candidate concrete, not a published hypothesis
